concepts.headline: Hey Ladies Over 60!
concepts.prompt: Clean off-white background. Top-left, heavy dark navy text on two lines: "Hey Ladies" / "Over 60!" (the second line extra bold). Below it two short dark lines: "Every step on hard floors adds up." and, on a soft yellow highlighter swipe, "Put a cushioned rocker sole in between." Right half: a close crop of an older woman's legs in light khaki slacks walking on a sidewalk wearing the navy shoes with bright blue accents from the product reference. Left column: four thin grey leader lines pointing at the shoe, each with a two-line label in dark text: "Slip On," / "No Bending"; "Wide" / "Toe Box"; "Cushioned" / "Rocker Sole"; "Non-Slip" / "Grip". All text is huge, bold and high contrast for readers aged 60+, with at least 7% clear margin between every text element and every edge (the longest line spans at most 84% of the width). Light or mid-tone background so the shoe stands out; the shoe is shown at true proportions, never squashed or stretched. Never copy any word, logo or product from the second attached image (it is only a layout reference). No other text anywhere.
concepts.based_on: Angle-gap study 2026-10-30 (research/angle_gaps.md): Armadilo 'Hey Walkers Over 60!' (active image); hands-free/slip-on angle: Armadilo 72 ads, Konjoun 63, Hike 20; we have 4
